'''Operation Rising Fury''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Empire's Fury]] squadron and the Imperial Navy [[Battle of the Skaross system|defended]] an Imperial manufacturing station in the [[Skaross system/Legends|Skaross system]] and [[Battle of Mugaar|wiped out]] a Republic border patrol at [[Mugaar/Legends|Mugaar]].
